nodes.label: Variational relaxation energy Rel(Z,core)
nodes.rationale: Defined through a frozen-orbital energy functional in which Koopmans is EXACT (ceff = Q-1 is linear), so Rel = E_frozen - E_SCF >= 0 is the variational relaxation energy and nothing else - the structural check R0 can fail if the functional is wrong.

nodes.label: Single-responder decomposition Rel_b
nodes.rationale: Each shell b is re-solved alone to self-consistency in the frozen field of the others, so the lift can be attributed to a NAMED electron. The Rel_b table is computed regardless of outcome, so a failure of the dominance claim still names the carrier.

nodes.label: Own-shell partner dominance
nodes.rationale: The partner occupies the region the channel vacates, so its response to removal should be the largest single response, while the rest of the core is a common mode between cfg1 and cfg2. P - dZ' is second order because no responder is added or removed at fixed core; its l-sign is explicitly not derived (F93.2 stands) - only its magnitude.
